counting_rule: Count unique physical PDF pages with useful readable body text. Do not count section fragments as extra pages. Exclude figure-only/mostly-figure pages with insufficient standalone text, and conservatively exclude the mixed summary/exercises page and the license-only page. There is no 1500-character threshold for PDF pages.

review_method.text: Inspect layout-extracted text per page, headings, captions, sparse pages and license notice.
review_method.visual: Contact sheets covering all 41 pages; full-page renders for the listed detailed pages. Figures are not transcribed into the text corpus.
review_method.limitations: Image text and table structure are not guaranteed to be extracted. This review checks corpus eligibility; benchmark and grounding scores will be recorded separately.
